messages.text: What are the most important signal generation capabilities for applications in AI?

### Short answer
The passages do not provide a ranked list of “most important” signal generation capabilities specifically for AI applications; they only support listing signal-generation capabilities that are technically relevant to high-speed, wireless, mmWave, waveform-replay, and channel-emulation use cases, while AI-specific product fit is not directly verified [79][14].
| Capability | Supported facts |
|---|---|
| Wide RF frequency coverage | R&S SMW200A RF path A options cover `100 kHz to 3/6/7.5/12.75/20/31.8/40/44/56/67 GHz`, while RF path B can cover up to `44 GHz` depending on option [20]. R&S SMM100A covers `100 kHz to 44 GHz` [22]. |
| Wide modulation / RF bandwidth | R&S SMW200A supports standard baseband up to `160 MHz` RF modulation bandwidth and wideband baseband up to `2 GHz` RF modulation bandwidth [17]. R&S SMM100A supports internal RF modulation bandwidth up to `2 GHz` [22]. |
| ARB waveform generation and large waveform memory | R&S SMW200A wideband baseband ARB supports waveform length `1 sample to 256 Msample`, expandable with `K515` to `2 Gsample` [16]. R&S SMCV100B ARB supports `1 sample to 64 Msample`, expandable to `512 Msample` with `R&S®SMCVB-K511` and `1 Gsample` with `R&S®SMCVB-K512` [61]. |
| High sample rate waveform generation | R&S SMW200A wideband baseband sample rate is `400 Hz to 600 MHz`, extendable to `1200 MHz` with `K525` and `2400 MHz` with `K527` [16]. R&S SMCV100B sample rate is `400 Hz to 75 MHz` standard, extendable to `150 MHz`, `200 MHz`, or `300 MHz` with `R&S®SMCVB-K521/-K522/-K523` [61]. |
| Digital I/Q connectivity | R&S SMW200A digital I/Q input/output enables lossless connection with other Rohde & Schwarz instruments, including SGT100A, SMM100A, SMCV100B, and CMW500 for fading applications [18]. R&S SMCV100B digital baseband I/O supports `Dig. I/Q HS`, `LVDS`, `QSFP+/QSFP 28`, and digital baseband input sample rate `400 Hz to 300 MHz` [63]. |
| MIMO and fading / channel emulation | R&S SMW200A can scale from a single-path vector signal generator to a multichannel MIMO receiver tester, supports up to `8` signal sources, up to `64` fading channels, and up to `8` RF paths via SGT100A modules [17]. Its integrated fading section supports channel emulation bandwidth up to `800 MHz` and MIMO fading scenarios including `2x2`, `3x3`, `4x4`, `8x4`, `4x8`, and `2x4x4` [17]. |
| 5G NR / FR1 / FR2 signal generation | R&S SMM100A supports 5G NR signal generation for FR1 and FR2 [22]. R&S SMW200A supports internal digital standards including `5G New Radio`, LTE up to Release 15, NB-IoT, eMTC, WLAN, and other standards [20]. |
| mmWave waveform playback / ARB generation | R&S CMP200 provides IF vector signal analysis and ARB-based generator functionality, with remote radio heads for upconversion/downconversion to 5G NR FR2 frequencies [7]. R&S CMP200 option `R&S CMP-KW601` enables NR mmWave waveform playback and WinIQSIM2 waveforms for the ARB generator [8]. |
| Waveform replay from external sources | CMX500 GPRF Generator can generate ARB, CW, dual tone, or replay `.wv` waveforms [37]. The waveform replay source can be IQ capture, MATLAB, or other sources [39]. |
| Low phase noise / spectral purity | R&S SMW200A standard performance SSB phase noise at `1 GHz`, `20 kHz offset`, `1 Hz measurement bandwidth`, `level = 10 dBm` is `< –134 dBc`, typ. `–140 dBc` [89]. R&S SMCV100B SSB phase noise at `1 GHz`, `20 kHz offset`, `1 Hz measurement bandwidth`, `+10 dBm` is `< –100 dBc` standard and `< –125 dBc` with `R&S®SMCVB-K709` [64]. |
| Signal impairment / enhancement functions | R&S SMW200A options include AWGN, enhanced noise generation, notched signals, crest factor reduction, RF linearization, user-defined frequency response correction, digital Doherty, customized digital input, and bandwidth extension [93]. R&S SMM100A capabilities include internal real-time signal generation, arbitrary waveform generator, custom digital modulation, frequency response correction, envelope tracking, and HRP UWB [22]. |

R&S SMCV100B › 適用條件與規格定義
依 [[SMCV100B_specs_en_3608-0627-22_v1700]]，產品資料適用條件：

- 在 ambient temperature 儲存 `3 小時` 後，warm-up operation `30 分鐘`。
- 符合指定 environmental conditions。
- 遵守 recommended calibration interval。
- 已執行所有適用的 internal automatic adjustments。

規格定義：

- Specifications with limits：以範圍或限制值表示 warranted product performance，使用 `<, ≤, >, ≥, ±, maximum, minimum` 等標示。
- Non-traceable specifications with limits (`n. trc.`)：依 specifications with limits 測試，但因缺乏可追溯至 national metrology standards 的量測設備，Rohde & Schwarz 不保證。
- Specifications without limits：代表 warranted product performance，通常為尺寸或設定解析度等無或可忽略偏差的值。
- Typical data (`typ.`)：代表約 `80%` 量產儀器可達到的性能，或代表平均值。
- Nominal values (`nom.`)：代表性數值，不做 statistical evaluation，生產時不測試。
- Measured values (`meas.`)：來自個別樣品的 measurement results。
- Uncertainties：coverage factor = `2`，依 GUM 規則計算，考慮 environmental conditions、aging、wear and tear。
- Non-traceable specifications with limits、typical data、nominal values、measured values 不由 Rohde & Schwarz 保證。

R&S SMCV100B › I/Q modulation
- Operating mode：internal baseband I/Q。
- RF modulation bandwidth 最大 signal bandwidth 取決於 baseband option configuration：`8 kHz < f ≤ 240 MHz` 為 `±50% of carrier frequency`；`f > 240 MHz` 為 `±120 MHz`。
- RF frequency response：standard up to `120 MHz RF modulation bandwidth` 為 `< 3.5 dB`、`< 2.5 dB measured`；with `R&S®SMCVB-K547`、optimization mode high quality、up to `240 MHz RF modulation bandwidth` 為 `< 1.2 dB`、`< 0.3 dB measured`。
- Carrier leakage：mode internal baseband I/Q，referenced to full-scale input，`< –60 dBc`、`< –80 dBc measured`。
- Image sideband suppression：entire instrument in modulation bandwidth，up to `240 MHz RF modulation bandwidth`，`> 80 dB measured`，圖中少數頻率除外。
- Modulation error ratio：`> 40 dB measured`；測量條件為 single carrier waveform signal、`8 Msample/s`、root raised cosine rolloff、`α = 0.20`、`64QAM`、`level = 0.0 dBm`。
- Internal baseband characteristics：aliasing filter 具 amplitude、group delay、sin(x)/x correction；bandwidth rolloff to `–0.1 dB` 為 `250 MHz nominal`。

I/Q compensation settings：

| 項目 | Setting range | Resolution |
|---|---|---|
| Carrier leakage | `–10 % to +10 %` | `0.01 %` |
| I/Q imbalance | `–1 dB to +1 dB` | `0.01 dB` |
| Quadrature offset | `–10° to +10°` | `0.01°` |

R&S CMP180
[[R&S CMP180]] 是 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 的 **Radio Communication Tester**，用於 production / wireless communication device 測試，依文件可配置多埠 RF generator/analyzer、通訊標準 measurement options、waveform options 與 [[R&S VSE]] 分析能力。

R&S CMP180 › 產品定位

依 [[CMP180 Specifications Version 08.00]]，CMP180 支援 simultaneous receiver and transmitter testing，並提供 RF generator/analyzer no. 1 與可選 RF generator/analyzer no. 2 的多埠 RF 測試架構。

R&S CMP200 › 產品定位
依 [[CMP200_specs_en_5216-4391-22_v0800]]，[[R&S CMP200]] 與 [[R&S CMPHEAD30]] / [[R&S CMPHEAD50]] remote radio head（RRH）形成 5G NR FR2（mmWave）nonsignaling one-box test solution，目標應用為：

- R&D 的 RF parametric testing。
- Manufacturing 的 high-volume RF parametric testing。
- Fully assembled smart devices 的 pure radiated mmWave setup。
- 具 IF interface 的 mmWave RF integrated circuits 的 mixed radiated mmWave / conducted IF setup。
- 具 mmWave interface 的 mmWave RF integrated circuits 的 mixed radiated mmWave / conducted mmWave setup。

CMP200 本體提供 IF frequency range 的 vector signal analysis 與 ARB-based generator functionality；[[R&S CMPHEAD30]] / [[R&S CMPHEAD50]] 作為 compact remote radio head，負責 upconversion / downconversion 至 5G NR FR2 frequencies。分離式 one-box tester + RRH 架構可在 mmWave frequency range 使用較短 RF cable lengths，以改善 radiated test environments 的 link budget。

R&S SMW200A › Wideband baseband
- `R&S®SMW-B9` arbitrary waveform mode：waveform length `1 sample to 256 Msample`；with `K515` 到 `2 Gsample`。

- `R&S®SMW-B9F` 詳細 GNSS 規格見 `GNSS simulation for Rohde & Schwarz vector signal generators specifications`，文件 `PD 3607.6896.22`。

R&S SMW200A › 產品定位與架構
依 [[SMW200A_specs_en_3606-8037-22_v3100]]（Version 31.00，May 2026）與 [[SMW200A_config-guide_en_3606-8037-92_v0600]]（Version 06.00，May 2024）：

- [[R&S SMW200A]] 可從 single-path vector signal generator 擴充到 multichannel [[MIMO]] receiver tester。
- 支援最多 `8` 個 signal sources 與最多 `64` 個 fading channels。
- 可連接 [[R&S SGT100A]] signal generator modules，提供最多 `8` 條 RF paths。
- 最多可在 `2` 個 internal baseband modules 上配置 `8` 個 baseband generators，具 real-time coder 與 ARB。
- 單機可配置最多兩個 internal RF paths：RF path A 為 mandatory，RF path B 為 optional second RF path。
- Baseband section 分成 standard baseband section 與 wideband baseband section；standard baseband 最高 `160 MHz` RF modulation bandwidth，wideband baseband 最高 `2 GHz` RF modulation bandwidth。
- 可選 integrated fading section，channel emulation bandwidth 最高 `800 MHz`；最多可安裝 `4` 個 fading modules，提供最多 `64` 個 logical faders。
- 單一儀器可實作 MIMO fading scenarios：`2x2`、`3x3`、`4x4`、`8x4`、`4x8`、`2x4x4`。
- Path-specific、baseband-specific 與 fading/MIMO software options 採 floating license concept；若同一 feature 需同時在兩個 paths 或兩個 baseband generators 使用，通常需安裝兩份對應 option。

R&S SMW200A › Digital I/Q
- Standard digital baseband outputs 至少需 `R&S®SMW-K18`；wideband digital baseband outputs 至少需 `R&S®SMW-K19`。
- Digital I/Q input/output 可用於 [[R&S SMW200A]] 與其他 Rohde & Schwarz 儀器之間的 lossless connection，例如 [[R&S SGT100A]]、[[R&S SMM100A]]、[[R&S SMCV100B]] 或 CMW500 wideband radio communication tester 的 fading applications。
- DIG I/Q interface 符合 `R&S®Digital I/Q Interface PAD-R`，level `LVDS`，connector `26-pin MDR`。
- HS DIG I/Q interface 符合 `R&S®Digital I/Q Interface 40G PAD-R`，connector `QSFP+/QSFP 28`。
- Wideband HS DIG I/Q standard system configuration mode：40G up to `1.05 GHz`，50G up to `1.25 GHz`；advanced mode with `R&S®SMW-K822` input up to `500 MHz`，with `R&S®SMW-K823` input up to `1000 MHz`。

- 來源是 Rohde & Schwarz 的 `R&S®SMW200A Vector Signal Generator Specifications`，文件資訊 `PD 3606.8037.22`，`Version 31.00`，日期 `May 2026`，頁尾另標 `May 2026 (ch)`。

- 支援 internal digital standards，例如 `5G New Radio`、`LTE up to Release 15`、`NB-IoT`、`eMTC`、`3GPP FDD/HSPA/HSPA+`、`GSM/EDGE/EDGE Evolution`、`WLAN IEEE 802.11a/b/g/n/j/p/ac/ax/be/ad/ay`、`DVB-S2/DVB-S2X`；來源同時另列 waveform packages for signals from [[R&S WinIQSIM2]]，其中 [[R&S WinIQSIM2]] requires an external PC。

The passages do not provide a ranked list of “most important” signal generation capabilities specifically for AI applications; they only support listing signal-generation capabilities that are technically relevant to high-speed, wireless, mmWave, waveform-replay, and channel-emulation use cases, while AI-specific product fit is not directly verified [79][14].
| Capability | Supported facts |

| Wide RF frequency coverage | R&S SMW200A RF path A options cover `100 kHz to 3/6/7.5/12.75/20/31.8/40/44/56/67 GHz`, while RF path B can cover up to `44 GHz` depending on option [20]. R&S SMM100A covers `100 kHz to 44 GHz` [22]. |

| ARB waveform generation and large waveform memory | R&S SMW200A wideband baseband ARB supports waveform length `1 sample to 256 Msample`, expandable with `K515` to `2 Gsample` [16]. R&S SMCV100B ARB supports `1 sample to 64 Msample`, expandable to `512 Msample` with `R&S®SMCVB-K511` and `1 Gsample` with `R&S®SMCVB-K512` [61]. |

R&S SMCV100B sample rate is `400 Hz to 75 MHz` standard, extendable to `150 MHz`, `200 MHz`, or `300 MHz` with `R&S®SMCVB-K521/-K522/-K523` [61]. |
| Digital I/Q connectivity | R&S SMW200A digital I/Q input/output enables lossless connection with other Rohde & Schwarz instruments, including SGT100A, SMM100A, SMCV100B, and CMW500 for fading applications [18]. R&S SMCV100B digital baseband I/O supports `Dig. I/Q HS`, `LVDS`, `QSFP+/QSFP 28`, and digital baseband input sample rate `400 Hz to 300 MHz` [63]. |
| MIMO and fading / channel emulation | R&S SMW200A can scale from a single-path vector signal generator to a multichannel MIMO receiver tester, supports up to `8` signal sources, up to `64` fading channels, and up to `8` RF paths via SGT100A modules [17]. Its integrated fading section supports channel emulation bandwidth up to `800 MHz` and MIMO fading scenarios including `2x2`, `3x3`, `4x4`, `8x4`, `4x8`, and `2x4x4` [17]. |

R&S CMP200 option `R&S CMP-KW601` enables NR mmWave waveform playback and WinIQSIM2 waveforms for the ARB generator [8]. |
| Waveform replay from external sources | CMX500 GPRF Generator can generate ARB, CW, dual tone, or replay `.wv` waveforms [37]. The waveform replay source can be IQ capture, MATLAB, or other sources [39]. |
